attchmntText: Globe Civil Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Globe Civil Projects Limited published newspaper advertisements in Financial Express and Jansatta on November 16, 2026, regarding un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The standalone net profit after tax was 38.08 million for the quarter and 71.60 million for the half year. Consolidated net profit after tax was 38.70 million for the quarter and 54.75 million for the half year. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on November 14, 2026. Statutory auditors conducted a limited review and issued an unmodified review report. Amberg Engineering India Private Limited proposed changing its registered office from Haryana to Delhi, subject to confirmation by the Central Government. Objections must be filed within fourteen days. Hinduja Housing Finance Limited issued sale notices for immovable properties in Uttarakhand and Uttar Pradesh under the Securitization Act, with e-auctions scheduled for December 2026.

attchmntText: Globe Civil Projects Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 16, 2026, titled "PRESS RELEASE DATED NOVEMBER 16, 2026 FOR UN-AUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER/HALF YEAR ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Globe Civil Projects Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 14, 2026. For the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, total income was 1,157.89 million rupees. EBITDA stood at 116.63 million rupees with a margin of 10.07 percent. Net profit was 38.70 million rupees. For the half year of fiscal year 2027, total income reached 2,087.12 million rupees. EBITDA was 274.68 million rupees with a margin of 13.16 percent. Net profit was 109.62 million rupees. The company received a Letter of Acceptance for a project valued at 1.20 crore rupees from the Central University of Punjab. The project has a completion period of 120 days.

attchmntText: MONITORING AGENCY REPORT FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Globe Civil Projects Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The report was issued by CARE Ratings Limited regarding the utilization of proceeds from the Initial Public Offer aggregating to Rs. 119.00 crore. The monitoring agency confirmed no deviation from the objects of the issue. All proceeds were utilized as per the offer document objectives. During the quarter, the company utilized Rs. 2.97 crore for capital expenditure and Rs. 1.69 crore for general corporate purposes. The entire amount was spent from current accounts. The company disclosed an income tax demand notice of Rs. 80.19 lakh for the assessment year 2018-19 and a prosecution complaint regarding TDS delay with a maximum liability of Rs. 20.00 lakh. The company stated these matters do not materially impact operations.

attchmntText: Globe Civil Projects Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Globe Civil Projects Limited announced the approval of its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting held on November 14, 2026. The statutory auditors, Jagdish Chand & Co., issued an unmodified limited review report. Total assets stood at 5,458.19 million as of September 30, 2026, compared to 5,219.46 million as of March 31, 2026. Net cash used in operating activities was 119.73 million for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The company identified Engineering, Procurement & Construction as its only reportable segment. All net IPO proceeds totaling 1,190.00 million were fully utilized by September 30, 2026.
